candidates.content_text:
The Opportunity:
Maitland City Council's Pathways program is a fantastic way to kick-start your career and gain professional experience in local government!
Commencing in January 2027, for a period of two years, we have two exciting opportunities for Graduate Civil Engineers to join our organisation.
In this role, you will undertake a graduate program developed specifically for you, giving you exposure to a range of civil engineering functions for the investigation and delivery of civil and recreation infrastructure projects undertaken by Council. These duties are going to help you develop a solid foundation to your civil engineering career.
About you:
To be successful in this role you will possess:
- Degree level qualifications in Civil engineering in the previous two years or completion of degree by January 2027
- Contemporary industry knowledge of civil engineering areas
- Experience and understanding in project support and the research, analysis and presentation of information
- Current Class C driver's licence
Benefits:
This Graduate position is temporary full time (two-year contract) with a commencing salary of $1,414.58 weekly, plus 12% superannuation. Graduates will also have access to Council's great staff benefits including:
- Flexible work arrangements
- One extra week of "My Leave" a year (to use how you like!)
- Ongoing training and development
- Fitness Passport
- Healthy Employee Program
To apply:
To apply for this opportunity, please click 'Apply Now' and submit your resume and cover letter.
Questions:
To viw the role charter click 'Apply Now'. If after reading the role charter you have any questions, please contact the recruitment team at Recruitment@maitland.nsw.gov.au
More information regarding Council's Pathways Program can be viewed via https://www.maitland.nsw.gov.au/pathways-program.
Applications close: Sunday 25th October 2027
Only candidates with current Australian work rights (Australian citizens, permanent residents, NZ citizens with a current passport, valid work visa) will be considered.
What happens next?
Once applications close, we will review all candidates' details against the role requirements and will be back in touch with you to advise the status of your application.
Please note, prior to an offer of employment being made, recommended candidates will be required to undertake a medical assessment (including drug and alcohol testing). Council also completes a range of other pre-employment checks which may include reference checks, psychometric testing or a criminal history check. For more information about the recruitment process, visit the "Jobs at Council" page on our website.
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
Maitland City Council is dedicated to providing a workplace that is inclusive and supportive and is reflective of the diverse community we serve. We support equal opportunities for all employees, and encourage applications from people from all cultures, nationalities, identities, and abilities. We believe all employees have the right to feel valued, respected and heard. If you have any special considerations or accessibility requirements, please let us know in the recruitment process how we are able to meet your needs.
 If you require special assistance, or have any questions about the recruitment process please contact us for a confidential conversation (Recruitment@maitland.nsw.gov.au)

candidates.content_text:
Build your career with an organisation that is invested in your success. 
Maker Consulting Services is looking for a motivated Civil Engineering Undergraduate or Graduate to join our growing Newcastle team. Whether you're currently studying and looking to gain meaningful industry experience alongside university; or completing your degree and ready to begin your graduate career, this role offers the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing to real projects from day one. 
You'll work alongside experienced engineers on land development, infrastructure, roads and stormwater projects across Newcastle, the Hunter and broader NSW, gaining practical experience that complements your university studies and builds the foundation for your professional career. 
At Maker, we believe in providing a flexible work lifestyle. This has inspired us to change the way we work, leaving behind the traditional 5-day work week. Instead, Maker has adopted a 4-day work week, providing you with a day off during the week and giving you the time to catch up on life and do more of what you love!  
For undergraduate candidates, we offer flexibility around university timetables and exam periods, allowing you to gain consistent industry experience while completing your degree. 
Why join Maker 
Maker is a fast-growing, multi-disciplinary consultancy with more than 65 employees across 4 offices in NSW and Victoria. In addition to Civil Engineering, we specialise in Town Planning, Surveying, and Project Management which provides you with the opportunity to collaborate across a wide range of exciting projects. 
You’ll enjoy:
- Hands-on mentoring from experienced civil engineers, including direct exposure to senior members of our Newcastle team.  
- Real project involvement from the outset - not just observation or administrative tasks.  
- Experience across land development, roads, stormwater, infrastructure and multidisciplinary projects.  
- Opportunities to develop your skills in industry-standard civil design and modelling software.  
- A supportive culture where questions are encouraged and knowledge is shared. 
- The opportunity to grow from undergraduate engineer through to graduate and increasingly independent project responsibilities.  
- A 4-day working week, giving you more time to enjoy life outside work 
- Modern offices and regular team social events 
About the Role 
Located in our Newcastle office and working closely with our Newcastle Principal Civil Engineer, you will be exposed to a variety of projects that will introduce you to a broad range of civil engineering disciplines and progressively build your technical and professional capability. 
Your responsibilities will include: 
- Assisting with the design and documentation of civil infrastructure and land development projects, including roads, earthworks, stormwater drainage and utility infrastructure. 
- Developing practical experience using industry-standard civil design and modelling software. 
- Assisting with engineering calculations, technical assessments and preparation of reports. 
- Working with engineers, surveyors, planners and project managers to understand how projects progress from concept through to construction. 
- Participating in site inspections, project meetings and coordination activities where appropriate. 
You'll be encouraged to ask questions, learn from experienced professionals and progressively take on greater responsibility as your confidence grows. 
For undergraduate candidates, our aim is to provide meaningful, ongoing employment throughout your studies, with flexible part-time arrangements to suit university commitments and the opportunity to transition into a graduate position as you complete your degree. 
About You 
We're looking for someone curious, motivated and excited to build a career in Civil Engineering. 
We're looking for:
- Someone currently studying a Bachelor's degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering, or who has recently graduated from a relevant engineering degree. 
- A genuine interest in civil engineering and a willingness to learn. 
- An interest in design, problem-solving and seeing projects progress from concept through to construction. 
- Good written and verbal communication skills, with an interest in developing your technical writing capability. 
- Good time management, organisation and prioritisation skills. 
- The ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team. 
Whether you're part-way through your degree and looking to build industry experience alongside your studies, or approaching graduation and ready to begin your professional career, we'd like to hear from you. 
Ready to Build Your Career? 
If you're looking to gain meaningful civil engineering experience while completing your degree, or you're ready to take the first step in your graduate career, we'd love to hear from you. 
Please submit your resume and a short cover letter telling us a little about yourself, your studies and why you're interested in joining Maker by clicking the APPLY button.

candidates.content_text:
Civil Designer, 12d Modeller - Roads & Highways | Sunshine Coast
Help shape the future of transport infrastructure across Southeast Queensland.
At Aurecon, we're delivering some of Queensland's most important roads and highways projects. We're looking for a Civil Designer / 12D Modeller to join our Roads team and contribute to the design and delivery of TMR and transport infrastructure projects across the region.
This role is ideally based on the Sunshine Coast, with opportunities for candidates across Southeast Queensland who are open to working from or relocating to the region.
Whether you're an experienced designer or an emerging professional with strong 12D capabilities, we'd love to hear from you.
What you'll do
- Prepare civil road designs and 12D models for transport infrastructure projects
- Work closely with engineers, project managers and other design professionals
- Support the delivery of TMR and Main Roads projects across Southeast Queensland
- Produce high-quality design documentation and technical deliverables
- Contribute to innovative, practical and sustainable infrastructure solutions
What you'll bring
- Experience in civil design and/or 12D modelling within roads and highways projects
- Exposure to TMR/Main Roads projects and standards
- Strong technical skills and attention to detail
- Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team
- Relevant experience in transport infrastructure, road design or civil engineering projects
- Knowledge of Queensland road design standards and practices
How we support your growth
We believe your career should be a rewarding adventure. You will tackle some of the world's most complex infrastructure challenges, in an environment that supports your ambitions, where we hold ourselves, and each other, to the highest standards. Recognised by the AFR as a Best Place to Work in 2026, we embrace diverse perspectives, giving you the opportunity to make a real impact. 
Who we are 
We are an engineering consultancy with more than 6,000 people across Australia, New Zealand and Asia. We believe the world needs people who can engineer possibilities. They are the ones who can create infrastructure that makes life better for people and the planet. That is our purpose. Bringing ideas to life. This is The Aurecon Way. 
Ready for your next adventure? 
If this sounds like your next step, we'd love to hear from you. We value diverse experiences and welcome applications for part-time or flexible working arrangements. 
Our hiring decisions are made by people, not AI. We're most interested in your individual thinking and experiences-so please ensure your application reflects your authentic perspective.

Our client who is a first class civil engineering consultancy who is seeking a Graduate Civil Engineer to join their experienced Cairns-based engineering team.
This is an opportunity to apply your technical skills to projects that have a genuine impact, from roads that connect communities and drainage systems that protect property, through to bridges, culverts, water infrastructure and land development projects.
This consultancy provides civil engineering and project management services across government, private development, infrastructure and regional projects throughout Far North Queensland and beyond. You will be a hands-on member of the engineering team, contributing to the planning, design and delivery of a broad range of civil infrastructure projects.
This is more than producing drawings and technical reports. You will see projects progress from concept and design through to construction and completion, working alongside experienced engineers, clients, contractors and other stakeholders.

- Developing practical and cost-effective civil infrastructure designs
- Supporting road, drainage, stormwater, water and land development projects

- Assisting with project delivery and undertaking site inspections

- Working closely with senior engineers while developing your technical capability

- Practical experience in civil design is a must
- Exposure to roads, drainage, stormwater, water, subdivisions or similar projects

- Good attention to detail and an ability to manage competing priorities
- Clear written and verbal communication skills
- A practical approach to engineering and project delivery

They offer the opportunity to work alongside experienced Civil Engineers and project professionals on projects across both metropolitan and regional environments. - $75,000 - $85,000 + super, negotiable based on experience
- Relocation assistance available
- Diverse civil projects from concept and design through to construction
- Exposure to roads, drainage, water, infrastructure and land development
- Hands-on project and site experience
- Mentoring from experienced senior engineers
- Ongoing training and professional development
- Opportunity to contribute ideas and influence project outcomes
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Long-term career stability and genuine project variety
How To Apply
To build your career with a company that values quality engineering, practical solutions and the work you deliver, please click Apply and please include any civil design experience you have undertaken in your application.
About Us
With Head Office in Cairns and offices in Townsville and Brisbane. We specialise in professional, administration, engineering and industrial recruitment, permanent and temporary placements for both commercial and government enterprise. We are proud to connect great people with meaningful careers.

Ready to kick-start your engineering career on some of Southeast Queensland’s most exciting infrastructure projects?
Seymour Whyte's Graduate Program gives ambitious engineering graduates the opportunity to work on major projects, take on real responsibility from day one, and develop the technical, commercial and leadership skills needed for a successful career in construction.
Through our structured two-year development program, you'll gain hands-on experience across major civil infrastructure projects, work alongside industry leaders, receive dedicated mentoring and build the skills and confidence to accelerate your career.  You'll be trusted with real responsibility, supported to grow and given the opportunity to make a genuine impact while helping deliver infrastructure that connects communities.
If you're ready to learn, grow and help shape the future, we'd love to hear from you.
About the Project
We have an exciting opportunity for a Graduate Civil Engineer to join our Cressbrook Dam Safety Improvement Project, a major infrastructure upgrade that will strengthen the dam's flood capacity, improve resilience to extreme weather events and enhance long-term community safety.
This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience on a complex and high-profile project while working alongside experienced industry professionals. You'll be exposed to a broad range of civil engineering disciplines and play a meaningful role in delivering infrastructure that will benefit local communities for generations to come.
Located in the picturesque Toowoomba region, this role offers the chance to build your career in a supportive project environment while enjoying the benefits of regional living.
The successful candidate will be required to work away from home, with attractive living away from home (LAFHA) and project allowances provided.
Why Join Seymour Whyte?
At Seymour Whyte, we believe the best way to learn is by doing. Our structured Graduate Development Program is designed to fast-track your career through hands-on project experience, mentoring from industry leaders and tailored professional development opportunities.
From day one, you'll be embedded in a live project team, contributing to the delivery of major infrastructure projects that shape communities across Australia. You'll gain exposure to a range of disciplines, build your technical and commercial acumen and develop the confidence to take ownership of meaningful work early in your career.
Throughout the program, you'll be supported by experienced mentors, participate in structured development workshops, and connect with a national network of graduates and professionals who are invested in your success.
What's in it for you?
- Work on a landmark civil infrastructure project from day one
- Gain exposure to multiple disciplines across project delivery
- Receive structured mentoring, coaching and development support
- Learn from experienced industry leaders and subject matter experts
- Build a strong professional network across projects and regions
- Be part of a collaborative, supportive and high-performing team culture
- Access career opportunities within the VINCI Group, a global leader in construction, infrastructure and concessions
Whether your passion lies in construction delivery, engineering, project management or leadership, our Graduate Development Program will provide the foundation, support and opportunities to help you build a rewarding and long-term career with Seymour Whyte.
To learn more about our Graduate Program, click here.
About You
You're in your final year of a Bachelor of Civil Engineering and ready to turn everything you've learned into real-world experience on major infrastructure projects.
Whether you've gained experience through an internship, vacation work, industry placement or part-time employment, you're eager to learn, build your skills and make a meaningful contribution from day one.
We're looking for graduates who are curious, motivated and excited about a career in civil construction.
You'll bring:
- Final-year studies in a Bachelor of Civil Engineering
- Practical experience through internships, vacation programs, placements or other employment
- A genuine passion for civil construction and infrastructure projects
- A positive attitude and willingness to learn from experienced industry professionals
- Strong communication and teamwork skills
- A commitment to safety, collaboration and creating a positive team culture
- Flexibility to travel or relocate as opportunities arise throughout your career
Most importantly, you're ready to take the next step, embrace new challenges and build a rewarding career delivering projects that make a lasting impact on communities across Australia.
Seymour Whyte Benefits
- Employee recognition and awards that celebrate contribution and achievement
- An employee share program, providing the opportunity to invest in the long-term success of the business
- Birthday leave, because celebrating life's milestones matters
- The option to purchase additional leave to support travel, study or personal commitments
- Fitness and wellbeing discounts through WHEREFIT (gym memberships, meal plans and fitness brands)
- Travel, retail, lifestyle and wellness discounts
- Workplace banking benefits and everyday financial savings through CommBank and Flare
Seymour Whyte is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds, including veterans.
Our commitment to an equitable construction industry extends to an inclusive culture that embraces our differences and gives everyone the opportunity to grow and be equally valued. We're unified in our direction toward having a workplace that is balanced and fair for all.
Next Steps:
- Submit your CV online to apply for this role
- All successful applicants will be required to undergo a pre-employment medical and criminal history check
- Applications will only be accepted from candidates who have the right to work in Australia
To learn more about us, visit www.seymourwhyte.com.au

Working closely with engineers and designers, you'll contribute to projects from concept through to detailed design, gaining exposure to a broad range of clients and industries. Starting with Project Initiation Documents developed by Strategic Asset Management, you’ll coordinate investigations and detailed designs, refine cost estimates and progress the approvals needed for capital works program entry.

 - Develop clear project scopes, specifications and budget requirements.
 - Coordinate investigations, technical advice and detailed design activities.
 - Prepare and refine cost estimates, checking assumptions, contingencies and constructability.
 - Progress approvals, utility clearances, statutory consents and other project requirements.
 - Prepare complete project packages for review under the City’s Project Management Framework.
 - Resolve risks and gaps early, considering procurement, construction sequencing and handover requirements.
Your work will help the City make informed investment decisions and give delivery teams confidence in each project’s scope, cost and readiness.
What you’ll bring
You know what it takes to prepare an infrastructure project for delivery. You can work through technical detail, challenge assumptions constructively and bring the right people together to resolve issues.

 - Tertiary qualifications in Civil Engineering, Project Management, Construction Management or a closely related discipline**, or equivalent demonstrated experience in project planning and infrastructure development.
 - Experience planning civil infrastructure or construction projects.
 - Sound knowledge of cost estimation, contingency allowances and key cost drivers.
 - The ability to coordinate technical input across disciplines and progress third-party approvals.

 - Free Armadale Fitness and Aquatic Centre membership**, including the gym, pools, sauna and group fitness classes.

 - Novated leasing opportunities.

You don’t need to be actively looking for a new job to explore this opportunity.
For an initial confidential conversation, contact People Services on 9394 5189 or hr@armadale.wa.gov.au.

Cairns, QLD | Full-Time | Graduate / Entry Level
WIP Construction is looking for a motivated Graduate or Junior Estimator to join our Cairns-based team. This is an office-based position located in Cairns, Queensland. Applicants must be based in Cairns or willing to relocate.
This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build a career in commercial construction estimating. You don't need previous experience as an Estimator, we're more interested in finding someone with the right aptitude, attitude and genuine desire to learn.
You may be a recent graduate, currently studying, or at the beginning of your construction career and looking for an opportunity to develop practical, hands-on experience within an established commercial construction company.
The Role
Working alongside our experienced estimating and project team, you'll learn how commercial construction projects are priced, tendered and ultimately delivered.
As your experience develops, you'll be involved in:
- Reviewing construction drawings, specifications and tender documentation
- Assisting with quantity take-offs and pricing
- Preparing and issuing subcontractor and supplier enquiries
- Reviewing and comparing quotations
- Assisting with tender submissions
- Understanding project scope, methodology and construction requirements
- Building relationships with subcontractors and suppliers
- Working with our project delivery team to understand how estimates translate into live projects
- Developing your knowledge of commercial construction costs, trades and procurement
We don't expect you to know how to do all of this on day one. We'll teach you.
What we do expect is that you genuinely want to learn.
We're looking for someone who is curious, switched-on and interested in understanding how and why things are built and what they cost.
You may be studying or have recently completed a qualification in:
- Construction Management
- Quantity Surveying
- Civil Engineering
- Building & Construction
- Project Management
- Engineering
- Or another relevant construction-related discipline
We're also open to applicants from other backgrounds who can demonstrate strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills and a genuine interest in pursuing a career in construction estimating.
Previous estimating experience is not required.
More important to us is someone who:
- Has strong numerical and analytical skills
- Has excellent attention to detail
- Can read information carefully and ask questions when something doesn't make sense
- Is organised and able to manage competing priorities
- Communicates confidently and professionally
- Takes ownership of their work
- Has a genuine interest in building a long-term career in commercial construction
WIP Construction is an established Cairns-based commercial construction company delivering projects throughout Cairns and Far North Queensland.
You'll be joining a team where you'll have the opportunity to learn from experienced construction professionals and gain exposure to real commercial projects from tender through to delivery.
This isn't a graduate role where you'll spend months watching from the sidelines.
You'll be given real work, real responsibility and plenty of support while you develop your skills.
For the right person, there is significant opportunity to grow within the business and develop into an experienced Estimator.
If you're motivated, good with numbers, interested in construction and looking for somewhere to start your career, we'd like to hear from you.
Apply through SEEK with your resume and a short cover letter telling us a little about yourself, what you're currently studying or have completed, and why estimating and commercial construction interests you.

About Us 
SFDesign is a privately owned, multidisciplinary engineering and design consultancy located in Bentley, Perth. We specialize in delivering innovative solutions in Structural, Mechanical & Piping (SMP) design for both brownfield and greenfield projects. Our services include project management, engineering, design, 3D modeling, 2D drafting, and laser scanning, as well as on-site consignment services where our experts collaborate directly with clients. 
At SFDesign, we take pride in our inclusive and professional work culture. We regularly celebrate team and individual achievements with social events, fostering a friendly and collaborative environment. 
About the Role 
We’re looking for experienced SMP Designers/ Draftspersons using Autodesk Inventor or SolidWorks to join our growing team. In this role, you will provide design solutions and technical support across SMP disciplines, working closely with clients and internal stakeholders to deliver high-quality results. 
Key Responsibilities 
- 3D Modeling & Design: Create and develop detailed 3D models, assemblies, and systems using Autodesk Inventor or SolidWorks based on project requirements. 
- 2D Drafting & Documentation: Produce accurate technical drawings and documentation that adhere to industry standards. 
- Collaboration: Work with project teams to design and draft mining equipment, structures, and piping systems, ensuring alignment with engineering standards. 
- Client Engagement: Liaise with clients, Project Managers, and team leads to manage project progress and expectations from concept to delivery. 
- Technical Analysis: Interpret project data, specifications, vendor drawings, and design requirements to create practical engineering solutions. 
- Project Delivery: Ensure timely and precise completion of assigned tasks, including material take-offs, bills of quantities, and bills of materials. 
- Site Engagement: Conduct site visits for tasks such as laser scanning, inspections of mechanical and structural components, and other site-specific requirements. 
- Client Integration: Work on client premises as an integrated team member, contributing to projects as needed. 
- Mentorship: Provide guidance, training, and support to junior designers or draftspersons, fostering skill development and ensuring quality outputs. 
- Additional Tasks: Perform other responsibilities as required to support project objectives and deliverables. 
What We’re Looking For 
Mandatory Qualifications & Skills: 
- Advance Diploma or Diploma qualification in Drafting and Design; 
- Minimum of 2 years’ experience using Autodesk Inventor or SolidWorks (preferably in the mining industry). 
- Strong Autodesk Inventor or SolidWorks proficiency in 3D modelling and drafting. 
- Interest and experience in Structural, Mechanical & Piping (SMP) projects. 
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a collaborative mindset. 
- Full-time work rights in Australia. 
Desired Qualifications & Skills: 
- Familiarity with Australian and ISO Standards; and industry best practices. 
- A strong understanding of design tools, techniques, and principles. 
- Fast learner with a proactive attitude and the ability to adapt to diverse projects. 
- Exceptional time management and organizational skills. 
What We Offer 
- Supportive Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative and inclusive workplace culture that values your contributions. 
- Professional Development: Access opportunities for growth and skill enhancement to advance your career. 
- Convenient Location: Free parking available at our South of the River office in Perth. 
- Industry Exposure: Gain experience working across diverse industries and with a variety of clients. 
- Team Bonding: Participate in fun social events, including waterskiing trips, Friday lunches, and more. 
How to Apply 
If this sounds like the perfect role for you, please submit your resume and a cover letter highlighting your qualifications and experience. 
We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
